additional_info.subject: Recurring incident on charging station – SID R6 313033014001 / Follow-up on case #0437190
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I am following up regarding the charging station previously reported under case #0437190.
During charging session in the SID R6 313033014001 (Transaction ID 21634127), the vehicle did not charge properly overnight:
"1c5cf6ea-f835-458a-964d-864bb5335499",
"StopTransaction",
{
"meterStop": 121424624,
"timestamp": "2025-08-26T01:13:41.012Z",
"transactionData": [
{
"timestamp": "2025-08-26T01:13:41.012Z",
"sampledValue": [
{
"value": "75",
"location": "EV",
"unit": "Percent",
"measurand": "SoC"
},
{
"value": "100390",
"location": "Outlet",
"unit": "Wh",
"context": "Transaction.End",
"measurand": "Energy.Active.Import.Interval"
The driver had to reconnect the truck at 04:00 AM this morning.
As a result, the charge stopped at 75% (279 km range), with the following message displayed:
“Replace charging station – The charging station is working but not compatible.”
As a reminder, the previous case concluded that a hardware replacement was required. To date, this corrective action has still not been carried out, and we have no visibility on the intervention timeline.
This is becoming critical for operations. We urgently need:
1.    Confirmation of the diagnosis.
2.    A clear and firm date for the planned hardware replacement.
3.    An action plan to prevent this issue from recurring.
Attached are a photo of the dashboard and a screenshot from the application as supporting evidence.
Looking forward to your prompt feedback.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0446139-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R6 313033014001]Connector 1 Unavailable CRM:02681000698
additional_info.body:
Bonjour Malek,
Le problème ici provient d’une perte de communication entre le PLC et le SECC :
2025-08-26T01:13:34.732425+00:00 [FW070005G1] sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/9c6f9442569c[737]: PLC-Error-Flag 'SECC_DC1_MB_Problem_KF12' initial value true - (loss of communication DC1 and SECC)
Il s’agit d’une erreur connue sur notre chargeur, et la version V8.0.5 corrige ce problème de manière définitive.
Souhaitez-vous que je procède à la mise à jour de ce chargeur ?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL
